note: THE FREE-STACK ROSTER (2026-09-30). One row per source; read by research/free_stack_hunter.py every hour. Fields every row must carry: id, kind, cadence, auth, licence, machine_use_allowed, cursor, region, language, uses{direct,indirect,allocation} with the consuming organ, and the culture provenance source_culture / participant_structure / failure_mode_hypothesis. machine_use_allowed is a PROVENANCE label (LAWS 5e), re-derived each pass by libs/research/access_classifier. Add a source by adding a row; nothing is hard-coded in the hunter.
boundary: No crypto-exchange universe: coinpaprika is fetched only for bases the broker lists as Crypto CFDs; catalogue links to exchange hosts are refused and counted.

sources.name: Apple App Store top charts (marketing RSS), 10 countries x free/paid
sources.licence: Apple Marketing Tools public feed; terms permit linking/promotion, redistribution of the feed NOT granted
sources.cursor: none needed: each daily snapshot is a new point-in-time vintage (never backfilled)
sources.mechanism: consumer engagement leads reported revenue: a publisher's chart presence moves before its quarter is printed (MoonFox/QuestMobile method)
sources.failure_mode_hypothesis: app-chart attention in CN/JP/KR stores is driven by local holidays, gacha launches and platform rules that do not coincide with US consumer cycles, so the signal should fail on a different calendar than US web-traffic proxies
sources.blocker_prior: not reachable from the build sandbox (its proxy refuses the host); first live reading is the box's
